cases.name: mixed_results_legacy
cases.why: The nested result struct in the legacy regime.

cases.name: mixed_results_flexible
cases.why: The same nesting where every struct also carries its own tagged-field section.

cases.name: v3_error_message_present
cases.why: v3 adds ErrorMessage to the nested result struct; the converter requires it for the version it writes, and its nullability is the encoding decision v3 introduces.

cases.name: synthesized_populated_v0
cases.why: Every field this version declares, present and non-default: one element in every array, every nullable thing supplied. The defaults case leaves arrays empty, which hides every field of the struct the array would have held — a records field encoded with the wrong length prefix survived the whole corpus that way, because nothing ever reached the struct holding it.
